dedupe_keys.name: frequentation mesuree dans les parkings velos idfm

description: Fréquentation mesurée dans les Parkings Vélos IDFM is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données présente le taux d’occupation des Parkings Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités par un comptage du nombre de vélos ayant lieu chaque trimestre. La fréquentation mesurée est relevée une fois par trimestre. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Circulation douce, Parking, Mobilité. The portal shows 4,913 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
